info.name: image-resizer-goravel
info.description: Self-hosted image processing API (Goravel + govips/libvips). Submit a source image URL + requested sizes, poll for the generated WebP outputs. See README.md for full API/config docs.

variable.description: Set this to the "id" returned by Create Image Request, then use Get Image Request to poll it.

request.description: Returns 202 with { id, status: "pending" }. Copy the returned id into the request_id collection variable to use it with Get Image Request.
Demonstrates all optional per-size fields: mode, allow_upscale override, and quality override.

item.name: Create Image Request - size matrix (tiny to huge, upscale test)

request.description: Same source image run through 8 sizes from 10x10 up to 6000x6000, all with allow_upscale forced to true. The small sizes exercise the downscale path; the sizes larger than the source image's own dimensions (check the response's "source_image" field) exercise the upscale path. All use "contain" so only pure scaling is being compared, no cropping/stretching. Poll with Get Image Request afterwards and compare each output's actual width/height (and the source_image field) to see which sizes upscaled vs downscaled.

Local file upload instead of a URL. The "data" field holds the same JSON shape as the plain-JSON request (image_url omitted here since a file is provided). Click the "image" field's Select Files button in Postman and pick a local image before sending. Returns 202 with { id, status: "pending" } - the response's later "input_type" will be "upload" and "source_url" will be absent.

item.name: Create Image Request - both image_url and file (file wins)

request.description: Demonstrates the precedence rule: when both image_url (inside "data") and an uploaded "image" file are present, the uploaded file wins and image_url is silently ignored. Select a local file for "image" before sending, then compare the polled result's source_image dimensions against the file you picked (not gallery/2.jpg) to confirm.
Expected: 422 with an { errors: {...} } body - invalid image_url and an empty sizes array.
Poll this until status is "completed" or "partially_completed". Each entry in "images" has a "url" you can open directly to view the generated WebP.
